daily_reports.observations: High initial retailer demand for Amul Spray, Taaza liquid milk, and Kool. Retailers in Malugram requested faster morning delivery cycles.
Active pitching of Amul Tru (Mango, Litchi) and Kool Cafe. Retailers in Malugram 3 noted strong consumer preference for 200ml beverage tetra packs.
Heavy demand for ₹35 Amul Butter (50g) across kirana counters; identified recurring stock-out gap at distributor level. High conversion on Amul Tru.
Conducted deep retailer interviews in Itkhola. Retailers noted competition from Purabi Lassi due to higher dealer margin; Amul brand pull remains strong.
Extensive kirana coverage in Ghungoor. Strong placement of Amul Regular Aata 1kg and Tinned Paneer 425g; chocolates placed in confectionery counters.
High retailer conversion on 2nd Link Road. Regular orders placed for Tinned Paneer and Sugar-Free Dark Chocolate. Retailers expressed satisfaction with product shelf-life.
Covered Fakirtilla market. High placement of Amul Fresh Mithai (Kaju Katli, Dudh Peda) and 35g chocolate bars across general stores.
Visited Silcoorie-Irongmara transit route. Evaluated cold chain availability. Retailers without refrigerators accepted ambient beverages and tinned paneer.
Re-covered Ghungoor route. Strong recurring order placement for Amul Aata and Paneer; retailers requested promotional POS display posters.
High order booking on 2nd Link Road. Re-order velocity for Tinned Paneer and Dark Chocolate remains consistent across kirana outlets.
Modern Times distribution run in Ambicapatty. High placement of Amul Lassi, Kool Kesar cans, and Tru Mango across high-footfall counters.
Itkhola beat coverage with Sengupta Agencies. Successfully placed Amul Kool PET bottles, Tru Litchi, and Milkshake Vanilla across retail points.
National Highway commercial stretch. Positioned Tru Orange and Lassi in highway food stalls and bakeries with strong evening footfall.
Hailakandi Road market visit. Retailers placed orders for core dairy and ambient beverages; noted demand for smaller consumer butter packs.
NS Avenue prime market beat. Placed Amul Kool Kesar cans, Lassi, and Kool PET bottles. Resolved local delivery logistics concerns with retailer.
NS Avenue survey day. Gathered detailed questionnaire feedback on margin satisfaction and competitor cold-drink shelf-space dominance.
Itkhola 2 beat visit. Retailers highlighted monsoon rainfall slowing beverage sales; focused pitches on ambient paneer and ghee.
Malugram 2 comprehensive survey run. Retailers noted that Coke and Sprite dominate chiller space; suggested Amul provide branded counter coolers.
Malugram 4 beat audit. Retailers confirmed 93%+ stock availability on core Kool and Lassi; highlighted lack of promotional schemes.
Malugram 3 follow-up run. Addressed delayed return settlement on damaged cartons; restored ordering relationship with 3 retail counters.
Malugram 1 market visit. Strong sales of Lassi and Kool Kesar. Retailers reported high consumer trust in Amul purity vs local unbranded dairy.
1st Link Road route. Heavy monsoon rainfall impacted soft drink sales; recorded steady sales for Amul Masti Buttermilk and Paneer.
Sonai Road market beat. Placed Kool Kesar cans and Lassi in pan bhandars and confectionery stalls. Retailers requested weekly credit flexibility.
National Highway route run. Retailers noted rain dampening cold beverage demand; placed Tru Fruit Drinks and long-life dairy products.
Saratpally market visit. Strong sales for Amul Kool Kesar and Lassi; placed Kadhai Doodh and Badam Shakers in premium grocery counters.
NS Avenue follow-up run. Retailers placed delayed orders for Amul Kool and Lassi; confirmed high consumer demand for chilled flavoured milk.
Hailakandi Road major order booking. High volume order booked at Cold Bar (120 Kool cans, 150 Lassi, 90 Masti); high demand for 1L Masti Buttermilk.
1st Link Road beat run. Placed multi-flavour Tru Fruit Drinks (Mango, Orange, Litchi) and Kool cans across grocery counters.
Malugram 2 high-conversion run. Record beverage conversion across 27 outlets (240 Lassi, 192 Kool cans, 180 Tru Chocolate); high volume turnover.
Saratpally commercial stretch. High demand for Kool and Tru Mango; retailers requested POS merchandising stands for chocolate displays.
Saratpally follow-up run. Consistent morning delivery confirmed; placed Lassi, Tru Apple, and Kool Badam Shakers across retail points.
Hailakandi Road route run. High volume placement of Kool cans and Tru fruit drinks; addressed minor pack indentation issue on-site.
1st Link Road route run. Placed orders for Amul Lassi and Kool across 8 retail counters; monitored competitor price points on local drinks.
Sonai Road final market run. Strong repeat orders for Amul Lassi and Kool Kesar cans; verified distributor fulfillment across retail counters.
